title: Immutable filesystem blob store + crash-consistent reconciliation (ARCH-19 blob subset)
mode: prototype-first (user directives D12/D13): write/finalize/read, reconciliation classification and the GC safety-delay gate proven hands-on over a live scratch PG through the worker's durable maintenance CLI; crash-point fault-injection battery, corrupt-bytes planting, purge traversal and streaming large-object reads deferred to wave 2
takeover: re-ran and repaired the abandoned worker's committed slice (178c31c, audited line-by-line); gates re-verified independently; smoke re-executed fresh - the takeover run caught a real defect the abandoned smoke missed (GC mark_purged vs the FND-03 finalize-guard trigger)

manual_qa.driver: product durable maintenance path: uv run python -m milpbooklm_workers --command put-blob/get-blob/reconcile/gc (same BlobPorts wiring the worker loop uses for the blob.integrity_scan job kind); transcript in .omo/evidence/task-6-manual-qa.log
manual_qa.harness: live scratch PG17 (127.0.0.1:29519, db fnd06_qa, roles per migrations/roles.sql, alembic 0001_baseline, scratch-only uuidv7() SQL shim kept in /tmp only, never committed)
demonstrated: S1: put-blob streams 124 bytes -> temp write + sha256/size validation + fsync -> atomic no-overwrite finalize (os.link) -> directory fsync -> ONE-transaction commit of blob_objects (state=finalized, finalized_at set, storage_path objects/0d/0d72c9cb...) + blob_references (source_version row)
S2: get-blob verifies digest + size before returning; readback file byte-identical to the original (cmp clean)

S3/S4: planted orphan temp, record-only unreferenced final, aged file-only unreferenced final, and referenced-row-with-missing-file; reconcile classified exactly orphan_temporary / unreferenced_final / missing_referenced; healthy referenced blobs produced no finding; scan was non-destructive

S5: gc with 48h safety delay (strictly > 24h max backup window, ch21) swept the temp (swept_temps=1), deleted exactly the aged file-only final (deleted_finals=1), never touched the missing-referenced incident (integrity_incidents=1), and settled the record-only finding without mutating its row
S6/S7: post-GC reconcile is stable/idempotent (only the two expected bookkeeping remainders); all finalized DB rows remain state=finalized - GC deletes files only, never mutates finalized rows

repairs_from_takeover: GC no longer mutates finalized rows: the abandoned mark_purged UPDATE (finalized->purged) is rejected by the FND-03 trg_blob_objects_finalize_guard trigger (finalized is terminal in the DB) and crashed any GC over a record-based unreferenced final; removed from port + adapter, GC now deletes files only and treats record-without-file findings as settled (ReconciliationFinding.file_present added as the action discriminator)
FilesystemBlobStore.delete_final: fsync the bucket dir only if it exists (a record-only finding's bucket dir is absent; the unconditional os.open raised FileNotFoundError mid-GC)
PgBlobRepository.commit_finalized: removed '# type: ignore[return-value]' - the committed row is read inside the same transaction with an explicit unreachable-None guard
runtime_deviations: scratch PG17 with a /tmp-only uuidv7() SQL shim (same recipe as FND-03/04/05) - the baseline's only PG18-specific element
engine DSNs must be postgresql+psycopg://: make_engine maps a plain postgresql:// to psycopg2, which is not installed

no staging-row-first two phase: the schema's storage_path is NOT NULL and digest-derived, so a row cannot exist before the digest is known; the guide's exact ordering is followed (temp -> validate -> fsync -> finalize -> dir fsync -> DB commit), and commit_finalized reuses/completes a stale staging row for the same digest

reconciliation skips staging rows (in-flight write intent) and purged rows; orphan-temp sweep inside gc is immediate by design - temps are never referenced and never part of a backup snapshot; only finalized object files observe the safety delay

GC leaves the GC'd object's record in state=finalized (terminal per the FND-03 trigger): reconciliation reports it as an unreferenced record-without-file, which GC settles (skips) - the bookkeeping remainder is intentional, not drift
wave2_deferred: crash-point fault-injection battery (kill at each protocol step) beyond the protocol-ordering proof
corrupt-bytes planting drill (missing-file incident proven hands-on; corrupt digest/size path implemented in get/verify/verify_content but not planted)

AD-016 purge traversal over blob references (the purged state exists in the schema but is unreachable via UPDATE from finalized - the finalize guard makes it terminal; a future privileged path owns it)
streaming reads for large objects (get materializes via read_bytes; verify paths already stream in 1 MiB chunks)
blob API endpoints (upload/download) - the API surface is deliberately untouched this task
concurrency test for the finalize race (os.link EEXIST dedupe path)
